initiatives.name: Association of Village Council Presidents
initiatives.description: Tribal nonprofit consortium based in Bethel serving 56 Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta communities. It runs social services, cultural programs and advocacy for tribes in the region.

initiatives.name: Bristol Bay Native Association
initiatives.description: Regional tribal nonprofit in Dillingham serving 31 Bristol Bay tribes with Head Start, family services, workforce training, and natural resources programs.
